testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for the Origin center point ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the Center Point row ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the point row ✔ And the menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note, Visibility and Relationships ✔ And the Center Point row is highlighted ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the Center Point row remains highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the empty viewport area again ✔ Then the Center Point row no longer has the filled selection highlight ✔ And the Center Point row retains a focus outline ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
